shared_elements: circular/disc motif on the body or torso area
symmetrical bilateral composition about a vertical axis
curved/looped arc motifs flanking a central element
band or belt-like element across the mid-body
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by anthropomorphic imagery organised symmetrically about a vertical axis and both include a prominent disc/ring motif on the torso area with arc-like curved elements to either side and a band across the mid-body. However, A depicts a crowded polychrome scene of two elaborately costumed profile-legged figures flanking a frontal animal-faced central figure with headdresses, earrings and handheld objects, while B shows a single massive frontal figure with a plain columnar head and only faint low-relief markings, so the shared traits are generic symmetry and disc motifs rather than a shared iconographic scheme.
